prompts.name: eye-world-luminous-network
prompts.prompt: Use case: compositing. Asset: artistic AwakeVC social preview, wide landscape approximately 1.905:1. Input image is the edit target and visual foundation. Make a new sibling variation of this Eye as a World artwork with subtle internet and AI magic integrated naturally throughout the world. Preserve its instantly recognizable giant golden eye formed by sweeping inhabited architectural bridges, radiant sun iris, Mediterranean fantasy cities, gardens, waterways, tiny human figures, warm ivory and mineral blue palette, tactile impasto oil painting and gold leaf, and small "awake.vc" signature bottom left. Keep the grandeur, painterly materiality and overall eye silhouette. Introduce only delicate evidence of technological intelligence distributed across the scene, as a discovery on closer inspection. No giant new focal objects, no realistic eyeball, no chrome robots, no circuit board pasted over the image, no binary digits, code, labels, screens, HUD, hologram rectangles, neon cyberpunk or excessive bloom. Only text "awake.vc". Variation: THE LUMINOUS NETWORK. Tiny warm gold nodes sit in architectural niches and tower pinnacles; hair-fine luminous filaments connect some distant towers across open air, following the elegant bridge contours. Soft gold and subtle cyan pulses travel along waterways and balustrades as if the city's paths carry information. A few small constellations connect above the harbor, almost indistinguishable from delicate stars. The sun iris contains barely perceptible intricate branching gold engravings suggesting shared intelligence. Keep at least 85 percent of the reference visual unchanged; technological magic is restrained and woven into the painting.
